/cuts/#0/text: The only smithy in a mountain village… customers dried up, and it's about to close!
/cuts/#1/text: Years ago, a little kid was always glued to this window. "When I grow up, I'll go adventuring with a sword like that!"
/cuts/#2/text: Now sixteen, that kid kicked the door wide open. "Boss! I'm gonna be an adventurer! But… I don't have a decent sword!"
/cuts/#3/text: "I can't pay, but I'll dig up the materials! Just make me the best sword ever!" For the first time in ages, the smith's grip tightened.
/cuts/#4/text: "Deal! I make the swords, you dig up the goods!" With the forge roaring again, our smithy's comeback began!
